verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents TeamViewer's session encryption, end-to-end or otherwise, and no protocol specification is cited. The only related item is a community comment questioning whether end-to-end encryption exists, which is skepticism rather than concrete counter-evidence. The axis applies to a remote-access tool, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an IT admin, sessions are encrypted end to end with the protocol documented, not just asserted
